data.name: InvalidEnvelope
data.value: The session snapshot envelope is incomplete or invalid. It cannot be resumed.

data.name: MissingETag
data.value: Cosmos did not return a session snapshot ETag. Conditional persistence cannot continue safely.

data.name: MissingContainer
data.value: The sessions container is missing. Create it with schema-v2 hierarchical partition keys and TTL before resuming sessions.

data.name: Conflict
data.value: The session snapshot was changed by another working copy or already exists. No overwrite or turn replay was attempted; reload explicitly or start a new session.

data.name: TooLarge
data.value: Cosmos rejected the session snapshot as too large. Reduce the serialized state or start a new session; no automatic compaction was attempted.

data.name: ConflictLog
data.value: Session snapshot conditional write conflict (HTTP {StatusCode}); no retry or overwrite was attempted.

data.name: TooLargeLog
data.value: Cosmos rejected the session snapshot size (HTTP 413).

data.name: AnonymousWarning
data.value: Session isolation is disabled for agent {AgentName}: no AgentIsolationKeyProvider is registered. Anyone who knows a client-supplied continuation id can resume that session.
